sn35.83:1.1: kho āyasmā Phagguno || la || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Phagguno Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.83:2.1: Atthi nu kho bhante taṃ cakkhuṃ yena cakkhunā atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādiṇṇavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya || la || || Atthi nu kho bhante sā jivhā yāya jivhāya atīte buddhe parinibbute || la || paññāpeyya || la || || Atthi nu kho bhante mano || yena manena atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādiṇṇavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte paññāpayamāno paññāpeyyāti || ||
sn35.83:3.1: Natthi kho tam Phagguna cakkhuṃ yena cakkhunā atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādiṇṇavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya || la || || Natthi kho sā Phagguna jivhā yāya jivhāya atīte buddhe parinibbute || pe || paññāpeyya || la || || Natthi kho so Phagguna mano yena manena atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādiṇṇavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte paññāpayamāno paññāpeyyāti || || Gilānavaggo tatiyo ||
sn35.83:4.0: Tassa uddānaṃ || || Gilānena dve vuttā || Rādhena apare tayo || Avijjāya ca dve vuttā || Bhikkhu Loko Phagguno ti || ||
